items.source: Indicates whether to ignore an unmapped HasChildQuery.Builder.type and not return any documents instead of an error.
items.translation: 指示是否忽略未映射的HasChildQuery.Builder.type，不返回任何文档而不是抛出错误。

items.source: The Maximum number of child documents that match the HasChildQuery.Builder.query allowed for a returned parent document.
items.translation: 返回的父文档允许匹配的 `HasChildQuery.Builder.query` 子文档的最大数量。

items.source: Minimum number of child documents that match the query required to match the HasChildQuery.Builder.query for a returned parent document.
items.translation: 返回的父文档必须匹配 HasChildQuery.Builder.query 所需的最小子文档数量。

items.source: Query that specifies the documents to run on child documents of the HasChildQuery.Builder.type field.
items.translation: 指定要在 `HasChildQuery.Builder.type` 字段的子文档上运行的查询。

items.source: Obtaining nested objects and documents that have a parent-child relationship.
items.translation: 获取具有父子关系的嵌套对象和文档。

items.source: Indicates how scores for matching child documents affect the root parent document’s relevance score.
items.translation: 指示匹配的子文档的评分如何影响根父文档的相关性评分。

items.source: Uses of HasChildQuery.Builder in org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query
items.translation: HasChildQuery.Builder 在 org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query 中的用途
